claim: A sector carrying a room-over-room link, and the one it joins, stay one sector each: later passes that split sectors (light pools, shadow cuts) leave them whole, or the pair no longer matches.
evidence: Gravesend's light stage exempts every linked surface (projects/blood-city/level/lights.py, OWN_LIGHT; projects/blood-city/level/pump_engine.py)
